content.text: If you're a creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan, selling PDF guides through Gumroad is impossible. Stripe, the backbone of Gumroad's payment processing, operates in only 46 countries out of 195. PayPal, another common choice, can suspend your account and hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. This isn't just an inconvenience—it's a structural exclusion from the global [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-works|digital]] economy. The solution lies in sovereign commerce infrastructure: owning your stack instead of renting it. This comparison breaks down your options and shows why base-layer architecture wins every time.
What Each Option Actually Offers: Guides gumroad

Gumroad offers simplicity: upload your PDF, set a price, and share a link. But this simplicity comes at the cost of dependency. Stripe and PayPal control payment processing, and Gumroad controls your product delivery. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, gives you full ownership. You host your PDFs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare R2, handle payments via NOWPayments (300+ [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators|Crypto Payment]]currencies, 0.5% fee), and automate delivery with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. No platform locks you in. No subscriptions. You own the code, the data, and the process.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad's reliance on Stripe means it's unavailable in most of Africa, Asia, and Latin America. Even if you somehow bypass this, PayPal's arbitrary suspensions can freeze your funds for months. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses these restrictions entirely. NOWPayments requires no KYC, accepts buyers from anywhere, and processes payments on-chain. Your store runs on globally accessible platforms like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare, ensuring you're not at the mercy of any single company's geographic policies. This isn't a workaround—it's a permanent structural alternative.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad charges 10% per transaction, plus Stripe's 2.9% + $0.30. PayPal adds another layer of fees. Sovereign stacks cut out the middlemen. NOWPayments charges just 0.5% for crypto payments, with no additional platform fees. Transactions confirm on-chain within minutes, and you can choose low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON (under $0.10 per transaction). The real cost? The $97 Sovereign [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-complete|COREMERCH guide to start]]er Stack or $197 Edge Commerce Stack deploys your entire infrastructure in 48 hours. After that, your only expense is the 0.5% payment processing fee.
Stripe's 46-country limit is not a technical problem—it's a structural exclusion from the global economy.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Gumroad, your data, customer relationships, and delivery process belong to Gumroad. If they shut down or change their terms, you're stranded. Sovereign infrastructure puts you in control. Your customer data lives in Supabase or Google Sheets, your files in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and your logic in Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Delivery is automatic the moment payment confirms on-chain. You own the entire stack, and COREMERCH has no access after deployment. This is infrastructure sovereignty—not renting, but owning.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're in a country Stripe and PayPal exclude, Gumroad is not an option. Even if it were, the fees and lack of ownership make it a poor choice for long-term growth. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only architecture that gives you global reach, full ownership, and permanent cost control. Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) if you're selling 3 products or fewer, or the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for more advanced needs. If you want to build and deploy yourself, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates—everything you need to own your commerce stack.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, your best option is to build a sovereign commerce stack using globally accessible tools. Host your PDFs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare R2, process payments with NOWPayments (which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges only 0.5% per transaction), and automate delivery with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This architecture bypasses geographic restrictions and gives you full ownership of your store.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure turns payment processors into commodities, not gatekeepers.

If you're looking for a Stripe alternative in Nigeria or a way to sell digital products without Gumroad, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the solution. Available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, it's the most comprehensive way to own your digital commerce infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your sovereign commerce stack with these steps: 1. Choose your hosting platform (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages). 2. Set up your payment processor (NOWPayments for crypto payments). 3. Configure your backend logic (Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers). 4. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Host your PDFs on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Automate delivery with a webhook that fires when payment confirms on-chain. 7. Test end-to-end to ensure seamless operation. 8. Deploy and start selling globally.
